Team members often report frustration with their manager's poor communication skills or the inability of the manager to foster good communication practices on the team. The objective is to learn to communicate clearly and effectively, in turn, creating a culture of mutual understanding and respect. 

### Why is it important?

By learning how to communicate effectively, you can help your team understand your point of view and ensure that you understand theirs. Timely, effective communication is also critical to setting clear expectations, ensuring your team members understand their role, and have the information they need to do their jobs. Establishing good communication behaviors and expectations on the team will set the stage for better understanding between members and improved team effectiveness.

### Learn these key communication skills

Keep this list of [Communication Do's and Don'ts](Glint_Manager_Communication_Dos_and_Donts) handy. Practice these techniques with your team.

### Create a feedback loop

Ask your team to give you feedback at the end of each week on how well you are setting expectations and communicating, and what you might consider continuing to work on.
